newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide unit signs Manila Bay deals.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide unit signs Manila Bay deals.

text.p: Philippine retailer Uniwide Holdings Inc said on Wednesday its subsidiary Uniwide Sales Realty and Resources Corp had signed a joint venture deal and a lease agreement to develop parcels of land in the Manila Bay reclamation area.

Uniwide told the Philippine Stock Exchange that it had signed a 40-year lease contract to develop a 33,643 square metre property along the Manila Bay coastal road. Uniwide will build commercial buildings on the property in collaboration with various local owners of the land, it said.

It added that Uniwide also had signed a joint venture agreement with owners of a 88,895 square metre lot in Cavite, just south of Manila, to develop a commercial complex. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
